canonAnchor: 1987 Metal Gear MSX2 edition; character roles and beat/event order authority. Creative original dialogue/reactions are openly marked interpretive.
thesis: Plot is what Snake must do. Story is how the mission changes him and his human relationships. Neither should progress by background timer or gameplay proximity without earned proof.
doctrine: No unearned privileged knowledge, secrets or dialogue from future timelines
Every personal moment is anchored to a witnessed gameplay fact or an optional player-initiated radio call
Source plot flags and player outcomes are authoritative; dialogue/cutscenes never award an item or silently win a boss
Contradicting a character requires a motivated, observed event, not forced cynicism
Snake has agency through posture, silence, action and choice of contact; not all development is spoken aloud
Keep quieter scenes between intense threats; give players time to absorb changing relationships
Later-written subtext must never turn the original finale into an opening spoiler
Named cast require recognisable 1995 costume/face, real rigs, matched voice and expressions before production signoff

cast.name: Solid Snake
cast.canonicalPremise: Young first-operation FOXHOUND field agent; not the scarred veteran of later games

personalArc.start: Obey the mission and prove he belongs
personalArc.pressure: Stop treating command as a substitute for his own evidence
personalArc.payoff: Makes earned decisions, protects people he can realistically help, faces the final truth

cast.actingAndWriting: Character grows through observation, quiet competence, and choices performed by player; avoid exposition that tells him he is legendary

cast.name: Big Boss
cast.canonicalPremise: FOXHOUND commander; experienced mentor as he appears to rookie Snake in 1995

personalArc.start: Bring the new agent home with the objective completed
personalArc.pressure: Control what Snake learns about Outer Heaven
personalArc.payoff: His command relationship changes meaning only after the final earned revelation

cast.actingAndWriting: Never early-reveal mastermind role, Venom identity, nor claim every early clue proves guilt

cast.name: Gray Fox
cast.canonicalPremise: Experienced FOXHOUND operative and early prisoner; wounded and physically exhausted

personalArc.start: Survive captivity and warn a younger comrade of what he saw
personalArc.pressure: Accept that he cannot finish the mission alone
personalArc.payoff: Snake has gained a human peer, not merely a walking exposition terminal

cast.actingAndWriting: Avoid replacing all later missions with a permanent Gray Fox escort or invoking future cyborg imagery

cast.name: Kyle Schneider
cast.canonicalPremise: Resistance operative familiar with some Outer Heaven construction

personalArc.start: Help Snake navigate changes within the fortress
personalArc.pressure: Know that old plans may now be unreliable; need Snake to validate what is real
personalArc.payoff: Shared evidence becomes mutual trust, not an omniscient architectural satellite

cast.actingAndWriting: No knowledge of unvisited prison secrets; earned later loss handled only when source-valid

cast.name: Diane
cast.canonicalPremise: Resistance tactical ally and former singer

personalArc.start: Keep Snake alive using informed combat advice
personalArc.pressure: Build trust after Snake requests help instead of treating her as a boss spoiler dispenser
personalArc.payoff: Technical expertise with human vulnerability and personality, not just tutorial barks

cast.actingAndWriting: Contact only after 120.33 acquired from the correct POW; do not invent unearned private history

cast.name: Jennifer
cast.canonicalPremise: Resistance insider with a personal stake in the hostages

personalArc.start: Keep her cover while helping Snake get supplies
personalArc.pressure: Personal concern, especially for her brother, pressures the limits of tactical radio
personalArc.payoff: Agent-to-agent relationship becomes reciprocal through demonstrated rescue actions

cast.actingAndWriting: Her brother's fate must rely on genuine POW save and original gated knowledge

cast.name: Dr. Pettrovich Madnar
cast.canonicalPremise: Scientist coerced into work on Metal Gear

personalArc.start: Protect Ellen while disclosing as little as possible
personalArc.pressure: Snake needs the sabotage intelligence that Madnar will not simply volunteer
personalArc.payoff: Ellen's actual rescue changes his trust and willingness to help

cast.actingAndWriting: No false earlier full TX-55 pattern and no invented betrayal arc

cast.name: Ellen Pettrovich
cast.canonicalPremise: Captive civilian, not an inventory switch

personalArc.pressure: Retain an individual perspective rather than merely validating the scientist
personalArc.payoff: Survival matters through observable changed dialogue and ending consequence

cast.actingAndWriting: Only credited after she is physically freed; no false voice communications

cast.name: Prisoners of war
cast.canonicalPremise: Many different captives with source-specific intelligence

personalArc.start: Survive and provide firsthand local clues
personalArc.pressure: Snake's rescue actions and resources change what they tell him
personalArc.payoff: The human cost of infiltration is visible beyond boss fights

cast.actingAndWriting: One generic voice and model is unacceptable as final art

relationshipBeats.limit: Guide never gives exact wall coordinate

relationshipBeats.purpose: Snake asks why his gear is transmitting. Command offers a plausible incomplete answer, not a confession
relationshipBeats.sourceEvidenceNote: radio/equipment chirp and player inquiry before removal

relationshipBeats.purpose: Different doors mean new choices; Schneider cautions that floor plans and access permissions disagree
relationshipBeats.sourceEvidenceNote: Schneider's original limited-plan observation after card 3

relationshipBeats.purpose: Fox notices guard/dog routine at a distance while Snake controls a route
relationshipBeats.limit: Fox absent after original source departure where appropriate
relationshipBeats.sourceEvidenceNote: optional Schneider kennel/duct radio exists, only when actually in service sector

relationshipBeats.purpose: Diane's advice on suppressive fire is cautious and based on audible reload rhythm
relationshipBeats.limit: Only if Diane has been contacted legitimately
relationshipBeats.sourceEvidenceNote: Snake's aftermath reaction and limited source character dialogue

relationshipBeats.purpose: Command gives a broad instruction; Snake chooses the safe route from earned reconnaissance
relationshipBeats.limit: Do not hint at future Boss reveal

relationshipBeats.purpose: Diane warns about rotor wash/cover without telling Snake to use equipment he cannot own yet
Previously learned loading schedules now help Snake choose a return trip
relationshipBeats.limit: Prior disabled devices and bodies persist

relationshipBeats.purpose: Diane's tactical voice briefly cracks after witnessing the stakes, then recovers
Jennifer tests whether Snake is careful enough to keep her inside position undiscovered
relationshipBeats.limit: Only after original POW frequency / rank gate

relationshipBeats.purpose: Madnar fears for Ellen; Snake cannot obtain the pattern until he does the work
Insider information and robot movement provide alternatives to taking lethal damage
Ellen reacts as an individual with agency; rescue is emotionally complete before any reward
Madnar's resistance yields to direct evidence Ellen is alive; he provides the original sequence
The brother rescue pays off a long-established human fear, not a last-minute fetch quest
A rescued prisoner makes earlier commands newly disturbing, without retconning prior knowledge
The familiar codec timbre becomes personally unsettling, not merely a boss announcement
relationshipBeats.limit: Must follow truth beat and original narrative

relationshipBeats.purpose: Destroying Metal Gear validates earned science, courage and deliberate preparation
Two actors with shared history clash; Snake's actions carry the answer, not a monologue
relationshipBeats.limit: Do not import later game's future events

relationshipBeats.purpose: A brief quiet aftermath considers the humans Snake met and helped, without narrating future lore
